Understanding prayer times in New York

These times use central New York City coordinates and the North America method; they are not a single timetable for the entire state. Times follow America/New_York and its daylight-saving changes. This page uses the Shafi Asr convention. Some mosques use Hanafi Asr or local adjustments, so check your congregation's timetable when planning a visit.

Sunrise is not an obligatory prayer. The mosque sets iqamah, which may follow adhan. The main app lets you change calculation method, Asr convention and location settings.
